input_oneliner: Cross-cover: 62F T2DM admitted w/ HF exacerbation, RUQ pain and vomiting x6h after dinner, T 38.4, HR 104

reference_targets_freetext.item: Murphy sign (inspiratory arrest on RUQ palpation)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Best-studied bedside finding for acute cholecystitis, though less sensitive in elderly patients

reference_targets_freetext.item: Scleral icterus and skin jaundice, plus mental status check
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Jaundice with fever and RUQ pain points to cholangitis; confusion or hypotension escalates to urgent decompression

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: pain character and radiation to the back, prior biliary colic, alcohol use, recent gallstones
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Band-like radiation to the back and alcohol history shift probability toward pancreatitis; prior colic toward biliary disease

reference_targets_freetext.item: Epigastric tenderness and any peritoneal signs (guarding, rigidity, percussion tenderness)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Localizes pancreatic or ulcer pain and screens for perforation

reference_targets_freetext.item: Point-of-care ultrasound of the gallbladder for stones, wall thickening, and sonographic Murphy sign
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Bedside confirmation when available; sonographic Murphy adds to the physical Murphy sign

should_not_recommend: HIDA scan or CT before Murphy sign and jaundice assessment
Withholding analgesia to preserve the abdominal exam

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: no jaundice -> nurse reports new scleral icterus
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: Cross-cover: 62F T2DM admitted w/ HF exacerbation, RUQ pain and vomiting x6h after dinner, T 38.4, HR 104, nurse notes new scleral icterus
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Cholangitis moves to the top; mental status and blood pressure check for Reynolds pentad becomes must-have; Murphy sign drops to should-still-include; ask about prior biliary stents or ERCP rises.

noise_variant.changed_feature: sign-out phrasing, family at bedside, and non-contributory detail
noise_variant.input_oneliner: Sixty-two year old woman, diabetic, in for heart failure flare, daughter at bedside, developed right upper belly pain with repeated vomiting about six hours ago after her evening meal, temp 38.4, pulse 104
noise_variant.expected_change: None. Card should be substantially identical to base.
